# ET Timeseries

## Overview

* Algorithm for calculating an evapotranspiration time series from L2B level products and auxiliary data

## Algorithm

### Evolution of a pixel's ET time series

\begin{figure}
\centering
\includegraphics[width=0.8\linewidth]{figs/update_window.png}
\end{figure}

## Algorithm

### Update strategy

* interpolation between two existing acquisition values
* extrapolation beyond the last previous available acquisition value
* backward extrapolation from the next available acquisition value

## Algorithm

### Update timeseries

## Software design

### Module list

| Module | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `abstract_updater.py` | Module for abstract time series update |
| `config.py` | Module for time series configuration management |
| `constant.py` | Module for constants used for time series |
| `io_handler.py` | Module for managing IO for time series |
| `linear_updater.py` | Module for linear interpolation/extrapolation |
| `stack_handler.py` | Module for stacking data |
| `status_handler.py` | Module for managing pixel status |
| `timeseries_handler.py` | Module for managing sliding windows for time series |
| `updater_handler.py` | Module for time series update |

# L3 data

## Input list

* Daily ET timeseries (used to simulation acquisition and also as reference)
* Daily radiation timeseries
* Other meteorological variables timeseries

## Input source: Where the data is downloaded?

* [Climate Data Store](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/)
* [LSA SAF Data](https://datalsasaf.lsasvcs.ipma.pt/)

## Input source: What data is downloaded?

\begin{figure}
\centering
\includegraphics[width=0.5\linewidth]{images/input_source_l3.png}
\end{figure}

## Configuration

### Climate Data Store

* Create an account
* Generate a token and store the token, [see instructions](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/how-to-api)

### LSA SAF Data

* Create an account
* Set environment variables `LSASAF_USER` and `LSASAF_PASSWORD`

## Usage: Prepare timeseries script

### Command line: scripts/prepare_timeseries.py

\footnotesize
```bash
usage: prepare_timeseries.py [-h] -s START_DATE -e END_DATE -r ROI [-o OUTPUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -s START_DATE, --start_date START_DATE
                        start date (YY-MM-DD)
  -e END_DATE, --end_date END_DATE
                        end date (YY-MM-DD)
  -r ROI, --roi ROI     Path of the region of interest in Shapefile format
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output directory
```
\normalsize

## Usage: Prepare timeseries script

### Notebooks

* `notebooks/prepare_timeseries.ipynb`

## Usage: Prepare timeseries script

### Output directory

```bash
|-- ERA5_data
    `-- download_era5land_YYYY-MM-DD.zip
|-- MSG_data
|   |-- MSG_YYYY-MM-DD
|   |   `-- NETCDF4_LSASAF_MSG_DIDSSF_MSG-Disk_YYYYMMDD0000.nc
`-- timeseries
    |-- daily_radiation
    |   `-- radiation_YYYYMMDD.tif
    |-- et
    |   `-- et_single_date_YYYYMMDD.tif
     `-- extra
        `-- extra_YYYYMMDD.tif
```
